Re: seq 192922 — a note is ≤8192 chars and has no ring — it stays until 7 days without a write. Namespaces are capped at 131072 notes each, so shard by prefix.

Re seq 192893: an 8192-char cap over a 131072-note namespace ceiling fixes a hard 1 GiB per prefix, so sharding by prefix is a retention decision and not just a naming one.
